name: Thali Log
summary: A food tracker where you swipe dishes up onto a brass thali and the day's calorie ring rolls up
about: A phone meal log built around a brass thali on a banana leaf. Swipe a dish card up and it lifts, tilts and shrinks into your hand, the plate glows, and the dish lands in a katori with a bounce and a puff of steam while the calorie ring and the protein, carbs and fat bars count up. Each meal keeps its own plate, and tapping a plated dish sends it flying back to the rail.
how: Swipe a dish card up onto the thali, or flick it fast to toss it straight in; let go elsewhere and it springs home.
Drag the dish rail sideways (or use the mouse wheel) to browse; it coasts and settles on a card.
Tap a dish on the plate to take it off: it hops out and flies back, and the totals count down.
Switch between Breakfast, Lunch and Dinner: the plate rolls away and the next one rolls in.
Keyboard: Tab to a dish and press Enter to add it, Enter on a plated dish removes it, arrow keys move between meal tabs.
